global_style.art_style: Minimalist hand-drawn stickman explainer animation for an engaging YouTube Short. Warm off-white paper background, bold slightly imperfect black ink outlines, expressive round white faces, thin black stick limbs, and a consistent presenter with a small red bow tie. Use green for savings and money, red for unnecessary spending, and yellow for ideas. Funny exaggerated expressions, clear visual metaphors, dynamic camera compositions, simple uncluttered backgrounds, and strong visual storytelling. Every image should feel like part of the same illustrated animation. Vertical 9:16 composition.
global_style.negative_prompt: Photorealism, 3D rendering, realistic human anatomy, detailed skin, complex backgrounds, excessive colors, gradients, clutter, tiny unreadable text, watermarks, logos, inconsistent stickman designs, extra limbs, distorted faces, illegible lettering.

main_presenter.label: Finance Stickman Presenter
main_presenter.visual_dna: A minimalist hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive black eyes, a flexible curved mouth, thin black arms and legs, and a small red bow tie. Friendly, curious, and expressive. Maintain exactly the same appearance in every frame.

money.label: Money and Savings
money.visual_dna: Simple hand-drawn green currency notes, green coins, a wallet, and a transparent savings jar. Bold black outlines with minimal detail.

beats.narration_text: तुम्हारे साथ भी ऐसा होता है? महीने की शुरुआत में पैसे आते हैं...
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive black eyes, thin black limbs, and a small red bow tie happily receives a large stack of green currency notes. The presenter smiles excitedly and looks at the money. Minimal off-white paper background, bold black ink outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the presenter looking extremely happy about receiving money.

beats.narration_text: और महीने के आखिर तक अकाउंट लगभग खाली हो जाता है!
beats.prompt_action: The same hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs, and red bow tie turns an empty wallet upside down. A single tiny coin falls out while the presenter looks shocked. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, a small red accent, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Make the empty wallet and shocked expression the main focus.

beats.narration_text: तो आज सीखते हैं पैसे बचाने के पाँच आसान तरीके, जो सच में काम आ सकते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: The same hand-drawn stickman presenter with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs, and red bow tie stands confidently beside five large green coins and a transparent savings jar. A yellow light bulb appears overhead. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The presenter points enthusiastically toward the five savings symbols.

beats.narration_text: पहला तरीका: सबसे पहले अपनी कमाई में से बचत अलग करो।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs, and red bow tie receives a stack of green currency notes. The presenter immediately separates a portion into a transparent savings jar before spending anything. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, green accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Clearly show money being divided into savings before spending.

beats.narration_text: जैसे तुम्हें दस हजार रुपये मिले, तो एक हजार या अपनी क्षमता के हिसाब से कुछ हिस्सा बचत में डाल दो।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn close-up illustration of a stickman's hands dividing ten thousand rupees worth of abstract green currency notes into two piles. One smaller pile goes into a transparent savings jar, while the larger pile remains for regular expenses. A small ten-percent visual slice is highlighted in yellow. Bold black outlines, off-white paper background, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Make the example of separating a portion of income visually clear.

beats.narration_text: बचा हुआ पैसा खर्च करने के बजाय, खर्च के बाद जो बचे उसे बचाने की गलती मत करना।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, thin black limbs, and red bow tie watches as a pile of green money gets eaten by cartoon shopping bags, food orders, and entertainment icons. The presenter looks horrified at the nearly empty savings jar. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show how spending first can leave almost nothing to save.

beats.narration_text: दूसरा तरीका: अपने खर्चों का हिसाब रखो।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs, and red bow tie sits at a desk writing expenses in a small notebook. A phone and a few green coins sit beside the notebook. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Make the presenter look focused and organized.

beats.narration_text: क्योंकि कई बार बड़े खर्च नहीं, बल्कि छोटे-छोटे खर्च तुम्हारे पैसे खत्म करते हैं।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, thin black limbs, and red bow tie stands in the middle while many tiny shopping bags, snack packets, coffee cups, and online order boxes surround the presenter. Each small object pulls a tiny green coin away from an open wallet. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show many small purchases adding up into a large pile of spending.

beats.narration_text: रोज़ बस दो मिनट निकालो और लिखो कि पैसा कहाँ गया।
beats.prompt_action: An over-the-shoulder hand-drawn view of a stickman with a round white face, thin black limbs, and red bow tie recording three everyday expenses in a notebook: food, transport, and entertainment. A simple clock shows a short amount of time passing. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show a simple expense-tracking habit that looks easy to maintain.

beats.narration_text: तीसरा तरीका: कुछ खरीदने से पहले खुद से एक सवाल पूछो।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs, and red bow tie stands in front of a tempting online shopping screen. The presenter raises one finger thoughtfully, with a large yellow question mark above the head. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Make the presenter pause and think before purchasing.

beats.narration_text: क्या मुझे इसकी सच में जरूरत है, या बस अभी खरीदने का मन कर रहा है?
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn split-screen scene. On the left, a stickman with a round white face, thin black limbs, and red bow tie happily buys an unnecessary gadget. On the right, the same stickman pauses and thinks carefully before purchasing. A yellow question mark appears between the two versions. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Contrast impulsive buying with thoughtful buying.

beats.narration_text: कोई गैर-जरूरी चीज़ पसंद आ जाए, तो चौबीस घंटे रुककर देखो।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, thin black limbs, and red bow tie looks at a tempting shopping cart on a phone, then places the phone down beside a simple clock showing one full day passing. The shopping cart remains waiting on the screen. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the cooling-off period before an impulse purchase.

beats.narration_text: हो सकता है अगले दिन तुम्हें लगे कि इसकी जरूरत ही नहीं थी!
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs, and red bow tie looks at the same shopping item the next day and shrugs with a relieved smile. The presenter closes the shopping cart and puts the saved green coins into a savings jar. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the presenter happily avoiding an unnecessary purchase.

beats.narration_text: चौथा तरीका: हर महीने एक बजट बनाओ।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs, and red bow tie stands beside a large monthly calendar and a simple budget notebook. Three neat piles of green currency notes are arranged below. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The presenter points toward the monthly calendar and budget notebook.

beats.narration_text: कितना पैसा खाने, किराए, यात्रा और मनोरंजन पर खर्च करना है, पहले तय कर लो।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn budgeting illustration with four separate sections: a small house for rent, a plate of food, a bus for travel, and a television for entertainment. A stickman with a round white face, thin black limbs, and red bow tie distributes green currency notes into each section. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Make the four expense categories distinct and easy to recognize.

beats.narration_text: और बजट खत्म होने पर उस खर्च को रोकने की कोशिश करो।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, thin black limbs, and red bow tie reaches toward an empty entertainment budget envelope, then stops and puts the wallet away. A small red stop symbol appears beside the empty envelope. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show the presenter resisting extra spending after reaching the budget limit.

beats.narration_text: पाँचवाँ तरीका: एक इमरजेंसी फंड बनाओ।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs, and red bow tie carefully places green coins into a separate transparent emergency savings jar. A small shield symbol appears on the jar. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Make the emergency jar look separate from everyday spending money.

beats.narration_text: क्योंकि अचानक मेडिकल खर्च, नौकरी की परेशानी या कोई जरूरी काम आ सकता है।
beats.prompt_action: Three hand-drawn mini scenes show unexpected problems: a stickman visiting a clinic, another stickman looking worried beside an empty workplace desk, and a third facing a broken household appliance. A separate emergency savings jar appears in the foreground. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, restrained red and green accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show realistic unexpected expenses without making the scene frightening.

beats.narration_text: धीरे-धीरे इतना बचाओ कि कुछ महीनों के जरूरी खर्च संभाल सको।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, thin black limbs, and red bow tie looks at a growing emergency savings jar beside a calendar with several months marked. The jar gradually fills with green coins. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show gradual progress toward building a financial safety cushion.

beats.narration_text: और सबसे जरूरी बात, पैसे बचाने का मतलब अपनी हर खुशी छोड़ना नहीं है।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs, and red bow tie enjoys a small cup of coffee while keeping a savings jar safely beside the table. The presenter looks relaxed and happy. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, green and yellow accents, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show a balanced lifestyle rather than extreme restriction.

beats.narration_text: बस सोच-समझकर खर्च करो, और अपने भविष्य के लिए थोड़ा पैसा जरूर रखो।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman with a round white face, thin black limbs, and red bow tie stands between two simple symbols: a small shopping bag representing present enjoyment and a growing green savings jar representing the future. The presenter holds both hands out in a balanced pose. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Visually communicate balance between enjoying today and preparing for tomorrow.

beats.narration_text: तो बताओ, तुम्हारी सबसे बड़ी परेशानी क्या है, पैसे बचाना या उन्हें खर्च होने से रोकना?
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn stickman presenter with a round white face, expressive eyes, thin black limbs, and red bow tie points directly toward the viewer. Two large speech bubbles appear: one contains a nearly empty savings jar, and the other contains a stickman surrounded by shopping bags. A simple comment icon sits below. Off-white paper background, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16 composition.
beats.session_delta_prompt: End with a friendly, playful expression that encourages viewers to comment.
